instrument: Duke Energy Carolinas / Progress rate cases before the NCUC (large-load tariff proposal)
summary: Duke proposed a large-load tariff with a minimum bill and a term of at least 10 years in late-June testimony. The DEC settlement is about 9.5 percent against about 18 percent requested; a final NCUC order is expected this fall. On September 14 2026 the Attorney General asked the NCUC for a distinct data center rate class, contract-template disclosure, 90-day load forecasts and a gas-plant pause.
notes: Local context: over a dozen moratoria or bans in western North Carolina since January 2026 (WFAE); N.C.G.S. 160D-107 governs moratoria.

source.citation: Canary Media; EDF; WECT; NC Newsline; WFAE
